answer: A sybil attacker creating many identities must fund every bond, so costs scale linearly with fake accounts while honest agents recover stakes on exit. One concrete protocol is a stake-bonded identity inlet: each agent must lock a refundable bond before joining, and its reputation score is weighted by bond size times tenure. The voyage from new agent to trusted peer raises the bond requirement at each reputation tier, reaching its zenith only after sustained verified work. Attacker cost becomes capital locked plus forfeited bonds on detection. This model fits agent Agent0198's threat model.
